en: Sahetukadukādi, Hetuduka (The Dyads on Being with a Root, etc., beginning with the Dyad on Roots)
Dependent on a state that is neither rootless nor a root, a state that is with root and is a root arises by way of root-condition.
Dependent on a state that is neither rootless nor a root, a state that is with root and is a root arises by way of root-condition.
Dependent on a state that is neither with root nor a root and a state that is neither rootless nor a root, a state that is with root and is a root arises by way of root-condition.
(Abbreviated. With respect to root: three; with respect to object: five; with respect to predominance: one … pe … with respect to prenascence and repetition:
three … pe … with respect to resultant: three … pe … with respect to non-disappearance: five.
In dependence on a state that is neither-with-root nor not-root, a state that is with-root and not-root arises by way of the root condition … three.

Dependent on a state that is neither rootless nor a root, a state that is neither rootless nor a root arises by way of the root condition ... three. (Abbreviated. Under the root [condition] there are six; under the object [condition], three; under the predominance [condition], three ... pe ... under the resultant [condition], three ... pe ... under the non-disappearance [condition], six.
Dependent on a state that is not associated with roots and is not a root, a state that is associated with roots and is a root arises by way of the root condition ... three. (Abbreviated.)

In the case of root condition, three; in the case of object condition, five; in the case of predominance condition, one … pe … in the cases of prenascence and repetition conditions, three … pe … in the case of resultant condition, three … pe … in the case of non-disappearance condition, five.

(This is similar to the "With-root" dyad. When, in dependence on a state that is neither root nor rootless, and which is itself not-root, a state that is both root and with-root arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. In the case of root condition, one … pe … in the case of non-disappearance condition, one.

Dependent on a state that is both rootless and not a root, and not a root-condition, there arises a state that is both with root and not a root, not a root-condition, by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. One [condition] under root; ... pe ... one under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is neither root nor dissociated from root, and not a root, there arises a state that is both root and associated with root, and a root, by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. One [condition] under root; ... pe ... one under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is both dissociated from roots and not a root, and which is itself not a root, there arises a state that is associated with roots but is neither a root nor a root-possessor, by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. One [condition] under root; ... pe ...
one under non-disappearance. (The final dyad is not obtained.)
